theorem_cc: Every key parameter of braid groups B_n for n ∈ {Q, LAM², PHI3, PHI4, PHI6, J_INV, K, EIG_MAX} — generator count, Garside element length, Temperley-Lieb dimension, reduced Burau dimension, and permutation count — is an integer expression in the W(3,3) atoms with zero free parameters: gen(B_5)=LAM², Δ_3 length=Q, Δ_5 length=PHI4, TL_3 dim=EIG_MAX, TL_2 dim=LAM, Q!=MULT_K2, gen(B_8)=PHI6, gen(B_{13})=K.
